Chapter 1090: 21: Lin Yuan'S Foundation (Seeking Subscription)_3

Chapter 1090: Chapter 21: Lin Yuan’s Foundation (Seeking Subscription)_3

That also stems from a thirteenth-tier temporal lifeform.

The most crucial part is, as long as it’s an awakened Physical Body Divine Ability, Lin Yuan can thoroughly comprehend it to be applicable in the Chaos Void and other worlds.

“The talent of a thirteenth-tier lifeform…”

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but feel excited. Through the talent of a thirteenth-tier lifeform, one can fully discern the essence of this tier of temporal lifeforms.

Moyu Tower Master and other unparalleled Great Saints once paid an infinite price of blood and toil to hunt a wondrous lifeform with rich temporal bloodlines. Why?

Wasn’t it just to try to contact the subtle information of the thirteenth tier through its bloodline?

Lin Yuan, however, got straight to the point and directly condensed the talent from a thirteenth-tier lifeform.

…

“Now, in terms of Physical Body and Soul Body within my universe, I’ve already grown to the utmost limit, and I can completely step into the Master Realm.”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly and began to enter the Master Realm.

Of course, it’s just that this current physical body enters the Master Realm. As for the true body in the Chaos Void? He plans to be cautious about that.

Wait until this physical body completely enters the Master Realm, then go for the breakthrough over there.

With Lin Yuan’s profound accumulation, expanding the path to the Master is a matter of course, without any unexpected changes.

But if there’s a more stable method, why not use it?

This physical body in the Source World, Lin Yuan can abandon, but the true body in the Chaos Void, unless absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan is still reluctant to give it up.

If an extreme situation arises while expanding the path to the Master, with the physical body of the Source World exploring the way, Lin Yuan will be more composed.

“Hmm… Both the Physical Body and Soul are beginning to transform.”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed the subtle changes in himself, simultaneously regulating them to steer the changes towards the direction he desired.

“This physical body, in terms of foundation and depth, is not as good as the true body.”

Lin Yuan objectively evaluated, the true body in the Chaos Void endured the Chaos Void Origin Infusion thrice, amplifying the influence on the internal universe to an unprecedented extent.

Whereas in this Source World, there is no such ‘benefit,’ but the Fierce Sun Divine Body and the Seed of the Fierce Sun grant Lin Yuan benefits nearly equaling the true body.

…

City Lord’s Mansion.

One by one, the aura of Great Lords spread. For millennia, the tension between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain has grown, and both sides have mobilized multiple Great Lord-level powerhouses, ready to engage at any time.

Over at the capital of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, there is significant interest in the situation between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain, with a royal family member personally taking charge, directing this war. Most of the Great Lords gathered here have been mobilized by that royal family member.

“Yu Yan, you’ve come.” Lord Qingfen greeted Lin Yuan, who had condensed into form.

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

With so many Great Lords present, it would be somewhat discourteous if he, as a disciple of Lord Qingfen, didn’t show up.

However, Lin Yuan here is only the Primordial Spirit. As for the true body? It’s still in seclusion at the Sky Burning Court, experiencing the nuances of entering the Master Realm.

Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits convert through the “Illusory Reality” Secret Technique, making it impossible for outsiders to distinguish.

The other Great Lords present also looked towards Lin Yuan, nodding slightly with goodwill.

Being fellow Great Lords of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, when facing hostile ancient countries, there’s naturally no room for internal strife. The Great Lords present here are generally on good terms with Lord Qingfen.

The royal family member in charge will not summon Great Lords who have grievances with Lord Qingfen.

“Great Venerate Hongye.”

Lin Yuan sat beside Great Venerate Hongye, one of the few Great Lords he had interacted with.

A thousand years ago, the two had traded, with Lin Yuan exchanging the Myriad Formation Crystal with Great Venerate Hongye for a large amount of cultivation resources.

Great Venerate Hongye possessed terrifying strength, even surpassing Lord Qingfen.

“The war is likely to begin soon.” Great Venerate Hongye, who had a good impression of Lin Yuan, spoke with a slightly sentimental tone.

He is not a vassal of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and appears here entirely by the invitation of Lord Qingfen.

“Indeed, the Purple Dream Domain should be almost ready.” Lin Yuan nodded.

For a thousand years, he has devoted almost all his energy to cultivation and seclusion but has roughly understood the situation between the two domains.

After a millennium of preparation, the Purple Dream Domain has gathered a lot of strong individuals, as has the Qingfen Domain. Both sides are ready to go, waiting for someone to break the fragile balance.

“Later, we will go to the border.”

Lord Qingfen, seated in the main position, said. Going to the border is mainly to see how many Great Lords the Purple Dream Domain has sent over and to familiarize themselves in advance.

The Great Lords present chatted for a moment, with Lin Yuan mostly listening and observing the many Great Lords.

These Great Lords have all developed their unique path of power from the chaos. Lin Yuan secretly observes and often gains a bit of insight.

Previously, most of Lin Yuan’s time was spent in that crimson world, observing the figure of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun. However, the information contained within that figure was too vast, too grand.

Occasionally observing these Great Lords is also a different kind of experience for Lin Yuan.

“Most of the Great Lords of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country follow the path of the Chaos Flame.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, a few, like Great Venerate Hongye, besides the Chaos Flame, realized the path of Chaos Life.

This is also very normal. After all, the environment of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country is such, and the Flame of Fierce Sun mastered by the Ancestor has a significant impact on all living beings within the ancient country.

…

A moment later.

Under the leadership of Lord Qingfen, all the Great Lords present arrived at the border of the Qingfen Domain.

Qingfen City has a space-time passage directly leading to the border, which is also to prevent the Purple Dream Domain from suddenly starting a war, leaving the Great Lords of Qingfen Domain unable to support in time.

“What is this?”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly.

He had previously been to the border area between the two domains, but compared to now, the current border area gave Lin Yuan a completely different feeling.
